statement: Every selected family-chain projection layer has a declared source and target payload component.
Each projection preserves the selected layerwise payload refinement relation.
Source canonicalization then lift agrees with lift then target canonicalization, or refines under the phase2 relation.
Canonical lift soundness lets layer correspondences compose into whole-payload refinement.
Layerwise payload refinement preserves source obstruction payload meaning.
Obstruction preservation implies counterexample status preservation.
If status is not preserved, an operation-specific smaller witness is constructed.
A constructed operation-specific smaller witness has a strictly smaller support measure.
Projection/canonical/status/construction failures route to named escape or blocker.
Selected phase3 target has no hidden failure class outside projection/canonical/status/smaller-witness/escape rows.
